acceptanceCriteria: A doc gate fails when a tracked spec or build-log entry cites a decision number with no file in docs/decisions/.
Existing tree passes or each pre-existing dangling citation is listed and resolved.
A test covers the failure case.
body: Observed 2026-10-11 by the V1-0040 slice-2 lane (branch claude/v1-0040-slice2, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456). Branch claude/v1-0040-slice2 cites decision 0524 in spec status and build-log text, but the decision file lives only on PR #815's branch. `make decision-numbers-check` passed anyway (rc=0) because it checks numbering/uniqueness of present files, not that cited decisions exist. Expected: a reference like `decision 0524` or `docs/decisions/0524-*.md` in tracked docs/specs resolves to a present decision file, or the gate fails naming the citation. Actual: no check.
title: docs: decision-numbers-check does not notice a cited decision file that is missing from the tree
